checks: Exact checker grammar: fourteen FONT_META records, twenty-six ordered GLYPH_READY records, one aggregate preparation record, then either the sole CPU terminal or ordered adapter inventory plus twenty-six GPU passes and the exact GPU terminal. Trailing, omitted, duplicated, reordered, noncanonical, oversized and malformed records fail.

All frozen names, frame sizes, UTF-8/scalar counts and byte totals come from the two immutable JSON hashes. Dynamic font/planner counters are explicitly bounded observations, not independent exact counter goldens.
Per-case source/operation/row/mask/storage/CPU-work/dispatch caps and aggregate retained memory are checked. Counter arithmetic uses bounded Python integers and canonical decimal fields.

CPU-only reporting counts twenty-eight font comparisons and 688128 compared bytes; the 344956 retained reference bytes include literal inputs with zero literal CPU comparisons. GPU mode counts all twenty-six cases and 344956 bytes per adapter.

Parent reference identity requires the externally pinned manifest, schema/parent/encoding/count/byte identity, fourteen exact relative names, file hashes/lengths and zero packed high bytes. No reference output is regenerated or rewritten by this host.

Host verifies executable, fixed JSON, parent reference, its five execution modules and explicit loader bindings before/after successful processes. New outputs are exclusive; pre/post failures stop without further adapter starts and retain raw receipts/logs.

Successful acceptance requires normal checker exit, complete owned-descendant cleanup, zero surviving descendant count, empty checker and supervisor stderr, and no worker capture grant. Direct glyph mode launches no workers and correctly omits the browser capture gate.
Inherited supervisor keeps checker ownership until signalling and reaping. Cleanup failure or outer timeout cannot authorize another checker; the host retains an unsuccessful summary.
All sixteen synthetic protocol groups are source-only transcript/binding tests, with invented counters clearly distinguished from observed GPU/font outcomes. No synthetic expectation conflict found.

Supplemental loader tests use actual directories at exactly 256 and 257 entries; the accepted case checks all sorted bindings and digest caps, while the refused case asserts no file hash is attempted.

resolved_findings.issue: Initial loader_binding materialized and sorted the complete directory before applying its 256-entry limit.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root switched to os.scandir; the 257th entry is refused before append, sorting or hashing. At most 256 Path entries are retained and subsequently sorted. Final corrected host is bound above.
resolved_findings.new_tests: Two supplemental host-only boundary groups authored at root request; not executed by reviewer.

limits: Source/loader/reference pre/post hashes provide experiment provenance, not protection against an adversarial host mutating and restoring inputs during a run.
Explicit loader-directory binding does not enumerate transitive system or driver libraries; the source says so.
Inherited supervisor cleanup has bounded attempts and can report unresolved ownership; this review does not promise that signals always terminate an uninterruptible process.
No broad inherited process-helper redesign was undertaken. Root owns all process, protocol and GPU execution outcomes.

execution_attribution.review_method: Read held sources, author two authorized tests, compute hashes and write this separate scratch receipt.
